chapters.title: Chapter 158: From the Shadows
paragraphs: The sound of explosions had become a part of the base’s atmosphere.
More than a day had passed since the siege began, and no one had found a chance for real rest.
Only one day had passed, but it felt like an eternity.
In the internal corridors, doctors with pale faces were moving the wounded on mana stretchers.
The screams of pain, the smell of blood, and the sound of medical equipment colliding were all mixed together.
Mages were sitting on the ground one after another, absorbing mana crystals with trembling hands. Many of them no longer even had the ability to cast a simple spell.

They were forced to absorb the mana crystals that were part of the base’s emergency reserve with the most impure methods, they absorbed them faster, but for such crystals, which could each give 5 mana stats, they would only receive 1 or 2 stat points.

In normal circumstances, this was a great loss, the difference of one or two points might not seem like much, but for awakened ones for whom obtaining such stats was very valuable, losing even one unit was like an arrow to the heart.
But in the current situation, they had everything except enough time, and they had to become stronger as quickly as possible, no matter what.
The logistics staff were continuously transporting ammunition, scrolls, and potions to the top of the walls.
No one knew how long this situation would continue, no one knew how long they could hold out.
At first, they thought they could hold out for a week without problems, but after one day, they realized that if they could hold out for two more days, they would be lucky.
On the massive walls, deep cracks had appeared.
Several watchtowers had completely collapsed, and engineers, under the rain of enemy spells, were using mana and reinforced stones to carry out emergency repairs on the destroyed sections.
On the highest part of the wall... the level 37 commander—the woman in charge of this base, Commander Elizabeth—was still standing.
Her silver armor no longer had the shine of the first day. Parts of it were broken and covered in monster blood, yet her voice remained firm and a source of hope.
"Third unit, fall back!"
"Mages on the west side, provide cover!"
"Recharge the defensive crystals!"
Her commands were broadcast across the battlefield without interruption. If she fell... perhaps the entire defensive line would collapse within minutes.
A few hundred meters away... Kael’s group was still fighting on one of the toughest defensive lines.
Bren was holding his massive shield against a new wave of Ironhorn Marsh Drakes.
But his shield no longer looked like before—dozens of deep cracks covered its surface.
Bren’s hands were trembling from the pressure, and the veins in his neck were bulging out from under his armor. Every strike that hit the shield pushed him back several steps.

Rhea moved through the corpses with labored breaths, her clothes almost completely covered in blood. The left part of her armor was broken and her arm was wounded, but she still held her sword firmly.
Zak no longer had his usual smiles.
His daggers disappeared into the shadows again and again, splitting the throats of monsters, but the fatigue was clearly visible on his face.
Elias downed his last bottle of mana potion. His belt was almost empty. He was now forced to choose between treating people.
Not everyone could be saved. He was not the base’s only healer, but the others were not in better condition either, the number of wounded was increasing every moment.
Many of the healers were also completely occupied with support skills and had no time to heal.
Kael was also fighting the enemies with devastating lightning, and his mana was barely holding on. Looking at his reserve, he realized only two mana crystals were left for him.
He was one of the most important mages on the attack line and could not afford even a moment to regain his strength, or the tower he was defending might fall.
Rhea severed the head of the last Thunder Spine Serpent in front of her with one strike.
The serpent’s head fell a few meters away. She rested her sword on her shoulder and said with her usual tone.
"So where is that bastard?"
Bren frowned without turning his gaze.
"Who?"
"The same bastard who robbed us and took half the monster’s corpse."
"Lian?" Kael looked at her.

"I thought he loved showing off. Did he hide?" The girl continued with a sneer. She had no good view of that boy, even though he had saved them, she believed it was not worth paying him three times the plant’s value.
Half the monster’s corpse was enough, and this was even confirmed by the national awakened center’s laws.
Zak said nothing, his gaze scanned around, even he could not find Lian’s presence.
Kael did not take his gaze off the battlefield and was silent for a few seconds.
"No... I don’t think he ran away." He then said quietly, but even so, no real trace of him could be seen. He had been absent for a whole day.
At that same moment... one of the commanders suddenly shouted with all his might.
"Look behind them!"
Everyone instinctively turned around, and right at that moment...
BOOOOOM!!
A massive explosion shook the horizon. Several kilometers behind the monster army... the sky was suddenly split by blue streaks of lightning.
The lightning spread through the sky like the branches of a giant tree.
The next moment... dozens of Thunder Spine Serpents exploded simultaneously.
Their long bodies were torn apart among the lightning, blood and metallic scales scattered in the air.
The ground beneath the feet of thousands of monsters trembled. For the first time since the siege began... the orderly formation of the monster army was disrupted.
The monsters that had been advancing in an orderly manner until moments ago suddenly looked around in panic.
Roars intertwined, the rear ranks broke apart.
In the heart of those explosions... a shadow moved among the monsters. No one could see his face, only... wherever that shadow appeared...
Death followed.
Thunder Calamity.
This time Lian had set no limits for himself. Mana flowed from his body like a flood.
Countless strands of lightning were released from his arms, each bolt hitting one monster and then jumping to the next.
The lightning danced among the ranks of Thunder Spine Serpents.
One...
Two...
Ten...
Twenty...
The massive serpents exploded one after another, their screams lost in the thunder.
A few Ironhorn Marsh Drakes charged toward him with their armored bodies.
Lian did not even stop, and with one punch...
Thunder Calamity.
The compressed lightning exploded like a massive cannon, the first monster’s skull shattered, and the shockwave threw three other monsters into the air.
Their multi-ton bodies fell on the rear ranks, completely breaking their order.
Lian kept running, and every moment, with every new stat he gained, he added them to strength and mana. With each passing moment, he became stronger and stronger.
He could not hold them back, he had to keep getting stronger to break the military formation of the monsters.
Only then would his plan work.
For the monsters... he was just a fading shadow, and every time he appeared... several more corpses fell to the ground.
The monster army fell into confusion. Some were still attacking the walls, while others ran toward the rear.
Some searched aimlessly around. The previous commands were no longer being executed, and their orderly formation had completely collapsed within minutes.
Commander Elizabeth, level 37, did not waste this opportunity, and raised her sword.
"Now!"
At that same moment... all the mana cannons fired simultaneously.
Dozens of glowing projectiles split the sky, and the remaining mages also released their last reserves of mana.
A rain of fire, ice, lightning, and wind blades fell on the disoriented monsters.
Explosion after explosion, and hundreds of monsters were destroyed within seconds.
Rhea stared at the distance with wide eyes, watching the blue lightning exploding one after another behind the enemy army.
Her lips moved slightly.
"That..." She was silent for a few moments and then whispered in disbelief.
"That’s the same crazy guy..." Only one person in the base besides their captain could use lightning.
"I told you he didn’t run away." Kael gave a very small smile.
On another part of the wall... Seraphina had also forgotten the battle for a moment.
Her eyes fixed on those unfamiliar lightning bolts. She had never seen Lian fight before, but a feeling told her it was him, and she quietly whispered.
"Lian..."
But not everyone was happy seeing that scene.
A few kilometers away... on top of a black hill... the Abyssal River Drake stood motionless.
Its massive body cast a shadow over the battlefield like a dark mountain, and its gaze separated from the base walls.
Its red and golden eyes fixed on one point, the place where the lightning was constantly exploding.
Its pupils slowly narrowed. It sensed a familiar smell, and it... had finally found the attacker.
Lian was still advancing among the monster army.
Every second, several monsters fell, but suddenly... a heavy feeling settled on his body.
[ Abyss Veil duration has ended ]
Lian’s face turned ugly upon seeing this notification. He had been so immersed in battle that he had completely forgotten about this.
And suddenly, his sixth sense screamed with all its being.
Danger.
Danger of death.
Lian instinctively raised his head, his gaze falling on that distant hill.
But... the Abyssal River Drake was no longer there, and its place... was completely empty.
And he suddenly felt the presence of death beside him!

She had no good view of that boy, even though he had saved them, she believed it was not worth paying him three times the plant’s value.
Half the monster’s corpse was enough, and this was even confirmed by the national awakened center’s laws.
Zak said nothing, his gaze scanned around, even he could not find Lian’s presence.
Kael did not take his gaze off the battlefield and was silent for a few seconds.
I don’t think he ran away." He then said quietly, but even so, no real trace of him could be seen.
He had been absent for a whole day.
At that same moment... one of the commanders suddenly shouted with all his might.
"Look behind them!"
Everyone instinctively turned around, and right at that moment...
BOOOOOM!!
A massive explosion shook the horizon.
Several kilometers behind the monster army... the sky was suddenly split by blue streaks of lightning.
The lightning spread through the sky like the branches of a giant tree.
The next moment... dozens of Thunder Spine Serpents exploded simultaneously.
Their long bodies were torn apart among the lightning, blood and metallic scales scattered in the air.
The ground beneath the feet of thousands of monsters trembled.
For the first time since the siege began... the orderly formation of the monster army was disrupted.
The monsters that had been advancing in an orderly manner until moments ago suddenly looked around in panic.
Roars intertwined, the rear ranks broke apart.
In the heart of those explosions... a shadow moved among the monsters.
No one could see his face, only... wherever that shadow appeared...
Death followed.
Thunder Calamity.
This time Lian had set no limits for himself.
Mana flowed from his body like a flood.
Countless strands of lightning were released from his arms, each bolt hitting one monster and then jumping to the next.
The lightning danced among the ranks of Thunder Spine Serpents.
One...
Two...
Ten...
Twenty...
The massive serpents exploded one after another, their screams lost in the thunder.
A few Ironhorn Marsh Drakes charged toward him with their armored bodies.
Lian did not even stop, and with one punch...
Thunder Calamity.
The compressed lightning exploded like a massive cannon, the first monster’s skull shattered, and the shockwave threw three other monsters into the air.
Their multi-ton bodies fell on the rear ranks, completely breaking their order.
Lian kept running, and every moment, with every new stat he gained, he added them to strength and mana.
With each passing moment, he became stronger and stronger.
He could not hold them back, he had to keep getting stronger to break the military formation of the monsters.
Only then would his plan work.
For the monsters... he was just a fading shadow, and every time he appeared... several more corpses fell to the ground.
The monster army fell into confusion.
Some were still attacking the walls, while others ran toward the rear.
Some searched aimlessly around.
The previous commands were no longer being executed, and their orderly formation had completely collapsed within minutes.
Commander Elizabeth, level 37, did not waste this opportunity, and raised her sword.
"Now!"
At that same moment... all the mana cannons fired simultaneously.
Dozens of glowing projectiles split the sky, and the remaining mages also released their last reserves of mana.
A rain of fire, ice, lightning, and wind blades fell on the disoriented monsters.
Explosion after explosion, and hundreds of monsters were destroyed within seconds.
Rhea stared at the distance with wide eyes, watching the blue lightning exploding one after another behind the enemy army.
Her lips moved slightly.
"That..." She was silent for a few moments and then whispered in disbelief.
"That’s the same crazy guy..." Only one person in the base besides their captain could use lightning.
"I told you he didn’t run away." Kael gave a very small smile.
On another part of the wall...
Seraphina had also forgotten the battle for a moment.
Her eyes fixed on those unfamiliar lightning bolts.
She had never seen Lian fight before, but a feeling told her it was him, and she quietly whispered.
"Lian..."
But not everyone was happy seeing that scene.
A few kilometers away... on top of a black hill... the Abyssal River Drake stood motionless.
Its massive body cast a shadow over the battlefield like a dark mountain, and its gaze separated from the base walls.
Its red and golden eyes fixed on one point, the place where the lightning was constantly exploding.
Its pupils slowly narrowed.
It sensed a familiar smell, and it... had finally found the attacker.
Lian was still advancing among the monster army.
Every second, several monsters fell, but suddenly... a heavy feeling settled on his body.
[ Abyss Veil duration has ended ]
Lian’s face turned ugly upon seeing this notification.
He had been so immersed in battle that he had completely forgotten about this.
And suddenly, his sixth sense screamed with all its being.
Danger.
Danger of death.
Lian instinctively raised his head, his gaze falling on that distant hill.
But... the Abyssal River Drake was no longer there, and its place... was completely empty.
And he suddenly felt the presence of death beside him!

chapters.title: Chapter 159: The Unstoppable Pursuer
paragraphs: The blue lightning bolts were still dancing in the heart of the monster army.
Every time Thunder Calamity was released, several Thunder Spine Serpents were thrown into the air in an explosion of blood and lightning.
The Ironhorn Marsh Drakes were falling one after another under Lian’s devastating strikes.

After killing each monster, he would immediately add the stats point he gained to mana, endurance, and strength, and this had made it so that now killing level 24 and 25 monsters had also become easy for him.
He did not have time to look at his stats, but he was sure that more than 50+ stats points had been added to all three: mana, resistance, and speed.
But the more he added, the more he felt that he was reaching the maximum capacity of his body, which was normal, his body had still not passed the first evolution.
Even the most powerful monsters have a limit they can reach before they pass their first evolution.

It is just that their limit compared to humans was much higher, for example, the limit for an elite awakened one with a five-star class was a maximum of 2000 stats, this was the maximum they could reach before the first evolution.
Although this limit for awakened ones with four-star classes is 1500, and for three-star classes and lower, the maximum is 1000 stats.
He is not currently aware of his exact total stats, but the last time he distributed stats points among his stats before entering the ancient ruin, his total stats were 1571.
He is practically even stronger than the most powerful awakened ones with four-star classes at level 20, who are only half a step away from their first evolution.
While he is only level 14.
He looked at the new notification... well, now he was level 15.
Of course, now during this battle, considering the monsters he had killed and the new stats he had distributed, he had probably passed 1800.
He was curious to know what his limit was? 2000? Or 3000? Or 4000? Maybe even 5000?
The orderly formation of the monster army had completely fallen apart, but right when everything was going according to plan...
Suddenly, all the hair on Lian’s body stood up, without any prior warning... the blood currents, the heartbeats of the creatures, and the presence of thousands of monsters were imprinted in his mind.
But among all of them... there was one presence that was incomparable to anything else.
Massive... heavy and terrifying, and with unimaginable speed... it was approaching.
Not from the front, not from behind, but from above, and Lian’s eyes suddenly widened.
Without even a moment of thought... he immediately released all his speed and power and threw himself to the left.
The next moment... BOOOOOOM!!
A terrifying sound shook the entire battlefield, as if a meteor had fallen from the sky.
The ground collapsed within a radius of dozens of meters, the explosion waves threw soil, rocks, and even the bodies of nearby monsters into the air.
Dozens of Thunder Spine Serpents that had no chance to react at all were torn apart just by the impact wave.
When the dust cleared a little... Lian finally saw that monster from a distance of less than twenty meters.
Abyssal River Drake.
Shiny black scales, among which red veins were shining like a flow of lava.
Curved horns protruding from its head, and golden eyes in which no emotion could be seen except the hunt.
Red steam was coming out from between its giant teeth, which was even burning the surrounding air.
Lian felt it had become hard to breathe, the pressure of this creature’s presence... was heavier than almost anything he had experienced so far.
Almost, because it still seems a little weaker than the Dreadmaw Sovereign.
This was not just a difference in power, it was a difference in the level of existence.
The monster did not even pause for a moment, its massive tail moved with incredible speed.
The air tore like fabric, and Lian was only able to pull himself back thanks to Fallen Wolf Speed.
The creature’s tail hit a rock behind him, and the massive rock... turned into thousands of pieces in an instant.
Lian had not even landed yet when the giant claw came down from above, the ground split and deep cracks extended dozens of meters.
Lian dodged again, this was the only thing he could do, but he had not even found a chance to breathe when the monster’s mouth opened.
A wave of red energy in the form of a massive crescent was released, and everything in its path... trees, rocks, and monsters, all were split in half.
With his last moment of reaction, Lian threw himself behind the corpse of one of the Ironhorns.
The explosion from the wave’s impact threw the multi-ton body of that monster into the air, pieces of flesh and metal shells rained down around.
Lian jumped out from the dust, he did not even have time to think, only one conclusion had formed in his mind.
"Even one direct hit means death."
On the base walls... all eyes were fixed on that same point.
Rhea, who was fighting the monsters a few moments ago, suddenly lowered her sword.
"Damn it, he went straight for Lian." Even her usual voice no longer had a joking tone.
Bren cursed under his breath, Zak was staring into the distance with a completely serious face, and Kael clenched his fist tightly, worry could be seen on his face.
Commander Elizabeth also saw the scene, but right in front of her, three other Fallen ones were attacking the defensive line.
If she left her position... the wall would collapse at that very moment.
She just gritted her teeth, no one... could go to help.
Lian was still running away at full speed, Predator’s Instincts was still active.
"This bastard definitely came after me because it sensed the egg’s smell from me." He cursed under his breath, he had no doubt that this was the reason this Fallen one had come after him.
And what other reason could there be for a monster that was watching until now to suddenly come after him?
The level 35 monster was even willing to sacrifice thousands of its own monsters, just to get that egg back.
But this discovery... created a new idea in his mind.
He could not fight, but... he could use the monster itself.
Without the slightest hesitation, he changed his path, and ran toward the densest part of the monster army.
Hundreds of Thunder Spine Serpents were gathered together, and dozens of Ironhorn Marsh Drakes were also moving behind them.
The next moment...
The Drake attacked, its massive tail landed with a full spin, and dozens of Thunder Spine Serpents did not even have a chance to look.
Their bodies were shattered, the next claw... split three Ironhorns in half.
The wave of red energy... reaped the rear ranks.
The monster did not care at all, any obstacle between it and the egg... had to be destroyed... even if it was its own forces.
Lian kept running, wherever he went... death also moved with him.
But this time... death was not just from his side, the Abyssal River Drake was also massacring its own army.
Commander Elizabeth saw this scene and her eyes sparkled.
"Concentrate all fire on that monster’s path!"
In an instant... all the mana cannons changed their direction.
Massive glowing projectiles landed one after another, and the mages also released their remaining mana.
A rain of fire and explosive powers from concentrated mana all fell on that same path.
These were advanced weapons that had been built and developed by the world’s military industries over decades.
The monsters that had survived the Drake’s attacks were this time destroyed under the defenders’ fire.
The monster army truly lost control, the roars intertwined, the ranks broke apart, and the advance almost stopped.
But Lian... in the heart of that chaos... was thinking about something else, about the egg, if he took it out right now... and left it somewhere...
Maybe this monster would also stop chasing him, maybe the siege would end.
But... his gaze fixed for a moment on that unknown egg in his mental storage space.
The Devourer.
A creature that even the book of treasure had not been able to classify.
He... was not willing to lose it, unless it was the last solution, for now he had no plan to abandon it.
He had gone through a lot of difficulty and effort so far, and his life had been put at risk, at least by keeping that egg he would be sure it was worth it.
So unless it was the last solution, he really did not want to abandon it.
Suddenly... everything changed.
The Abyssal River Drake no longer attacked, but stood calmly, its massive mouth slowly opened.
Lian unconsciously slowed down.
The surrounding air began to tremble, a red and black point formed deep in the monster’s throat.
At first the size of a fist, then larger, larger, and the energy around it was being compressed.
Space was warping, the ground beneath the monster was cracking, and at that very moment...
Predator’s Instincts warned madly.
All of Lian’s senses were screaming, certain death... his pupils contracted violently.
His heart stopped for a moment, he... at that very moment understood that this attack... could no longer be dodged with just speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Solar Forge Aegis
paragraphs: All of Lian’s instincts were screaming at the same time.
Run.
But his mind, unlike his instincts, was calm, Predator’s Instincts was warning like crazy.
Certain death.
He felt that if he decided just a moment later, there would be no time left for anything.
His gaze fixed on the system panel, skills passed before his eyes one after another.
Fallen Wolf Speed... useless.
Diamond Skin... not enough, and against such an attack it had no value, maybe it would only increase his death time from 3 seconds to 3.5 seconds.
Finally, his gaze stopped on the last option.
Molten Armor.
The newest defensive skill he had obtained, he had not had the chance to test it until now, but just based on the description, he was sure it was his strongest defensive skill.
A very faint smile settled on his lips.
"So... it is time." Although even this skill with its current rank could not help, it needed to be made stronger, much stronger.
Without the slightest hesitation, he decided to upgrade it to its highest possible limit.
And suddenly, system notifications appeared before his eyes one after another.
[ 20 fragments used ]
[ Molten Armor has evolved ]
[ Rank: Great ( + ) ]
Upon seeing the rank, he still felt it was not enough, and without even looking at the description, he clicked on the upgrade option again.
[ 130 fragments used ]
[ Remaining fragments: 45 ]
Upon seeing the amount of fragments used, his eyes sparkled, this was the highest amount of fragments a skill had ever needed and consumed to reach Divine rank.
And then his gaze fell on the description.
[ Solar Forge Aegis ]
[ Rank: Divine ]
Armor forged from solar molten and condensed mana, transforming the user’s body into the core of living steel.
Effects: Massively increases both physical and magical defense by 1000%.
Distributes the impact of overwhelming attacks across the entire armor.
Emits extreme heat capable of melting or weakening ordinary weapons and armor.
Absorbs a portion of heavy incoming damage and converts it into mana.
Consumes 20 mana per minute. ]
The next moment... the mana inside Lian’s body began to boil, molten metal burst out from beneath his skin.
First it covered his arms, then his shoulders, chest, waist, legs, and within seconds, a magnificent armor covered his entire body.
A red and golden metal that seemed to have been forged in the heart of the sun, golden veins flowing like rivers of fire across the armor.
At that same moment, just for extra assurance, Diamond Skin was also activated.
Two defensive skills layered on top of each other, and despite having an A rank armor, he at least hoped to survive that strike.
After all, he could not keep two defensive skills active for long, or his mana would be completely drained.
Lian took a deep breath.
"Come on... let’s see if this is enough or not." Although it seemed like a long time had passed, not even 5 seconds had gone by.
At that same moment... the Abyssal River Drake released its attack.
Its massive mouth fully opened, a column of red and black energy, like absolute destruction, erupted from deep within its throat.
This was no longer a normal beam, it was as if death itself had taken form.
The entire path of the attack disappeared in an instant, the ground split, rocks melted, trees turned to ash before they even had a chance to burn.
Hundreds of Thunder Spine Serpents that were in the path did not even have a chance to scream.
Their bodies vanished in the blink of an eye, the massive Ironhorn Marsh Drakes were no different.
Their metal armors melted like wax, the wave of destruction advanced for kilometers.
For a few seconds... the entire battlefield was submerged in a red and black light, even the sky changed color.
Lian placed both his hands in front of his body.
"Endure it..." The attack covered a vast area, and he could not go to any side, everywhere he went, that attack was there.
Not just toward him... but even toward the base! And they also activated all their defensive power at once.
The next moment... impact.
There was no sound, only light, everything turned white, time stopped for a moment.
Then... pain, pain that was impossible to even imagine.
He felt every single bone in his body being crushed, the golden veins on the armor cracked one after another.
The molten metal began to break, Diamond Skin also cracked under that immense pressure.
The sound of defensive layers breaking like glass echoed in his ears, he was lifted from the ground and thrown hundreds of meters through the air at terrifying speed.
He passed through several massive rocks, each collision exploding a mountain of stone, and finally... he was buried under a pile of crushed rocks.
Although this was not the end, the massive attack went toward the base, all defensive lines were activated to counter it.
"Resist! If we fail here, we will all die!"
"Stop that damn attack with all your might!"
All the arrays and defensive layers were activated, the attack arrived but could not continue with the same speed.
A massive defensive power stopped it... although dozens of defensive lines suddenly collapsed.
The attack was stopped, but all the magical arrays and defensive layers of the base were destroyed.
Rhea lowered her sword, she said nothing, Bren held his breath, and Zak looked at the explosion site in disbelief.
Kael clenched his fists so hard that blood came out from between his fingers.
Seraphina’s face had completely lost its color, even Elizabeth forgot the attack for a few moments, everyone’s gaze fell on him to see Lian’s condition.
No human... could survive such an attack.
Everyone was worried... was he alive?
But... a few seconds later...
BOOOM!
The massive pile of rocks exploded from the inside, multi-ton rocks were thrown around, and from the dust... a shadow slowly emerged.
Lian.
His steps were unsteady, almost all his armor was destroyed.
Parts of the Solar Forge Aegis had shattered and were slowly separating from his body, his entire body was covered in blood.
Blood was flowing from the corner of his lip down his chin, his left arm was hanging limply, and his breaths were heavy and broken.
But... he was still standing.
This alone... was unbelievable to everyone, even the Abyssal River Drake stopped its movement for the first time.
Its golden eyes fixed on the human in front of it for a moment, as if even it had not expected such a thing.
Lian spat out the blood from his mouth, the taste of iron filled his entire mouth.
"Time to change strategy." His gaze slowly rose.
Only one choice remained.
He opened the mana panel, almost all the stats he had left... went into one stat... mana reached 650! But his remaining usable mana was 300 units.
[ Physical Strength: 468 ]
[ Spirit: 258 ]
[ Speed: 300 ]
[ Mana: 650 ]
[ Resistance: 380 ]
[ Stats Points: 0 ]
Eternal Frozen Apocalypse.
The next moment... all his remaining mana was released from his body.
Black clouds covered the sky, the sunlight disappeared, a cold wind began to blow.
A few seconds later... the temperature dropped at an unnatural speed.
The monsters’ breath froze in the air, the sky split, and massive ice crystals fell one after another.
But this was only the beginning.
BOOOOOOM! The frozen apocalypse began.
A storm of ice and absolute cold covered the entire field, hundreds of Thunder Spine Serpents froze inside ice before they could even run.
Their bodies turned into glass-like statues, dozens of Ironhorn Marsh Drakes were also buried under thick layers of ice.
A few moments later... all those statues shattered at the same time.
The sound of breaking ice filled the entire field, the cold wave spread for kilometers.
The ground, the trees, the rocks... everything turned white.
Even a few weaker Fallen ones were forced to retreat to escape that deadly cold, but it was useless.
When the storm ended... the entire monster army no longer existed.
Although they were not dead... just frozen.
But the price... was heavy, the system panel appeared before Lian’s eyes.
[ Your mana has reached 0 ]
[ All skills are automatically deactivated ]
The last particle of mana had also left his body, Solar Forge Aegis slowly collapsed and the molten metal turned into particles of light and disappeared.
Diamond Skin also turned off.
His body no longer had any protection.
His knees trembled, he could barely maintain his balance, breathing had become difficult, his vision was blurry.
He now had almost nothing left. No mana, no armor, and not enough strength to continue the battle.
A brief silence covered the field.
Then... the sound of heavy footsteps was heard.
From the thick ice mist... the Abyssal River Drake emerged.
Its body was covered in fresh wounds, a few scales were broken, the red veins on its body were bleeding.
But... not enough to stop it, even the freezing could not hold this monster for more than ten seconds.
The monster’s golden eyes were no longer emotionless... a human had managed to wound it.
And this... made the prey in front of it worth hunting.
The Drake calmly... took its first step.
The ground trembled beneath its feet.
Second step.
Third step.
Each step was like a hammer blow to the heart of the battlefield.
Lian raised his bloodied fist, his wounded arm was burning with pain, but he still did not retreat, his gaze did not separate from the monster’s golden eyes.
He knew well... if no help arrived at this very moment... the next attack... would be the last thing he would ever see in his life.

Without the slightest hesitation, he decided to upgrade it to its highest possible limit.
And suddenly, system notifications appeared before his eyes one after another.
[ 20 fragments used ]
[ Molten Armor has evolved ]
[ Rank: Great ( + ) ]
Upon seeing the rank, he still felt it was not enough, and without even looking at the description, he clicked on the upgrade option again.
[ 130 fragments used ]
[ Remaining fragments: 45 ]
Upon seeing the amount of fragments used, his eyes sparkled, this was the highest amount of fragments a skill had ever needed and consumed to reach Divine rank.
And then his gaze fell on the description.
[ Solar Forge Aegis ]
[ Rank: Divine ]
Armor forged from solar molten and condensed mana, transforming the user’s body into the core of living steel.
Effects: Massively increases both physical and magical defense by 1000%.
Distributes the impact of overwhelming attacks across the entire armor.
Emits extreme heat capable of melting or weakening ordinary weapons and armor.
Absorbs a portion of heavy incoming damage and converts it into mana.
Consumes 20 mana per minute. ]
The next moment... the mana inside Lian’s body began to boil, molten metal burst out from beneath his skin.
First it covered his arms, then his shoulders, chest, waist, legs, and within seconds, a magnificent armor covered his entire body.
A red and golden metal that seemed to have been forged in the heart of the sun, golden veins flowing like rivers of fire across the armor.
At that same moment, just for extra assurance, Diamond Skin was also activated.
Two defensive skills layered on top of each other, and despite having an A rank armor, he at least hoped to survive that strike.
After all, he could not keep two defensive skills active for long, or his mana would be completely drained.
Lian took a deep breath.
"Come on... let’s see if this is enough or not." Although it seemed like a long time had passed, not even 5 seconds had gone by.
At that same moment... the Abyssal River Drake released its attack.
Its massive mouth fully opened, a column of red and black energy, like absolute destruction, erupted from deep within its throat.
This was no longer a normal beam, it was as if death itself had taken form.
The entire path of the attack disappeared in an instant, the ground split, rocks melted, trees turned to ash before they even had a chance to burn.
Hundreds of Thunder Spine Serpents that were in the path did not even have a chance to scream.
Their bodies vanished in the blink of an eye, the massive Ironhorn Marsh Drakes were no different.
Their metal armors melted like wax, the wave of destruction advanced for kilometers.
For a few seconds... the entire battlefield was submerged in a red and black light, even the sky changed color.
Lian placed both his hands in front of his body.
"Endure it..." The attack covered a vast area, and he could not go to any side, everywhere he went, that attack was there.
Not just toward him... but even toward the base!
And they also activated all their defensive power at once.
The next moment... impact.
There was no sound, only light, everything turned white, time stopped for a moment.
Then... pain, pain that was impossible to even imagine.
He felt every single bone in his body being crushed, the golden veins on the armor cracked one after another.
The molten metal began to break, Diamond Skin also cracked under that immense pressure.
The sound of defensive layers breaking like glass echoed in his ears, he was lifted from the ground and thrown hundreds of meters through the air at terrifying speed.
He passed through several massive rocks, each collision exploding a mountain of stone, and finally... he was buried under a pile of crushed rocks.
Although this was not the end, the massive attack went toward the base, all defensive lines were activated to counter it.
"Resist!
If we fail here, we will all die!"
"Stop that damn attack with all your might!"
All the arrays and defensive layers were activated, the attack arrived but could not continue with the same speed.
A massive defensive power stopped it... although dozens of defensive lines suddenly collapsed.
The attack was stopped, but all the magical arrays and defensive layers of the base were destroyed.
Rhea lowered her sword, she said nothing, Bren held his breath, and Zak looked at the explosion site in disbelief.
Kael clenched his fists so hard that blood came out from between his fingers.
Seraphina’s face had completely lost its color, even Elizabeth forgot the attack for a few moments, everyone’s gaze fell on him to see Lian’s condition.
No human... could survive such an attack.
Everyone was worried... was he alive?
But... a few seconds later...
BOOOM!
The massive pile of rocks exploded from the inside, multi-ton rocks were thrown around, and from the dust... a shadow slowly emerged.
Lian.
His steps were unsteady, almost all his armor was destroyed.
Parts of the Solar Forge Aegis had shattered and were slowly separating from his body, his entire body was covered in blood.
Blood was flowing from the corner of his lip down his chin, his left arm was hanging limply, and his breaths were heavy and broken.
But... he was still standing.
This alone... was unbelievable to everyone, even the Abyssal River Drake stopped its movement for the first time.
Its golden eyes fixed on the human in front of it for a moment, as if even it had not expected such a thing.
Lian spat out the blood from his mouth, the taste of iron filled his entire mouth.
"Time to change strategy." His gaze slowly rose.
Only one choice remained.
He opened the mana panel, almost all the stats he had left... went into one stat... mana reached 650!
But his remaining usable mana was 300 units.
[ Physical Strength: 468 ]
[ Spirit: 258 ]
[ Speed: 300 ]
[ Mana: 650 ]
[ Resistance: 380 ]
[ Stats Points: 0 ]
Eternal Frozen Apocalypse.
The next moment... all his remaining mana was released from his body.
Black clouds covered the sky, the sunlight disappeared, a cold wind began to blow.
A few seconds later... the temperature dropped at an unnatural speed.
The monsters’ breath froze in the air, the sky split, and massive ice crystals fell one after another.
But this was only the beginning.
BOOOOOOM!
The frozen apocalypse began.
A storm of ice and absolute cold covered the entire field, hundreds of Thunder Spine Serpents froze inside ice before they could even run.
Their bodies turned into glass-like statues, dozens of Ironhorn Marsh Drakes were also buried under thick layers of ice.
A few moments later... all those statues shattered at the same time.
The sound of breaking ice filled the entire field, the cold wave spread for kilometers.
The ground, the trees, the rocks... everything turned white.
Even a few weaker Fallen ones were forced to retreat to escape that deadly cold, but it was useless.
When the storm ended... the entire monster army no longer existed.
Although they were not dead... just frozen.
But the price... was heavy, the system panel appeared before Lian’s eyes.
[ Your mana has reached 0 ]
[ All skills are automatically deactivated ]
The last particle of mana had also left his body, Solar Forge Aegis slowly collapsed and the molten metal turned into particles of light and disappeared.
Diamond Skin also turned off.
His body no longer had any protection.
His knees trembled, he could barely maintain his balance, breathing had become difficult, his vision was blurry.
He now had almost nothing left.
No mana, no armor, and not enough strength to continue the battle.
A brief silence covered the field.
Then... the sound of heavy footsteps was heard.
From the thick ice mist... the Abyssal River Drake emerged.
Its body was covered in fresh wounds, a few scales were broken, the red veins on its body were bleeding.
But... not enough to stop it, even the freezing could not hold this monster for more than ten seconds.
The monster’s golden eyes were no longer emotionless... a human had managed to wound it.
And this... made the prey in front of it worth hunting.
The Drake calmly... took its first step.
The ground trembled beneath its feet.
Second step.
Third step.
Each step was like a hammer blow to the heart of the battlefield.
Lian raised his bloodied fist, his wounded arm was burning with pain, but he still did not retreat, his gaze did not separate from the monster’s golden eyes.
He knew well... if no help arrived at this very moment... the next attack... would be the last thing he would ever see in his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 161: A Moment of Hope
paragraphs: For a few seconds... the entire battlefield fell into a heavy silence.
The cold wind was passing through the frozen plain and making the ice crystals dance on the ground.
Until a few moments ago, this place was a hellish battlefield.
But now... a massive part of the plain had turned into a frozen land.
Thousands of monsters were trapped inside thick layers of ice, in the very state they were attacking in.
Some still had angry faces, some had their mouths open, several Thunder Spine Serpents were frozen just as they were, with lightning still flowing between their metal horns.
The massive Ironhorn Marsh Drakes were also standing like giant statues on the ground.
Even a few Fallen ones, who until moments ago were commanding the monster army, were now completely buried inside ice.
The surrounding air had become so cold that even breathing was difficult, even the awakened ones on the walls just stared at the scene before them for a few moments.
No one expected a single person to be able to release such power.
It was a very terrifying skill, but fortunately it was clear that its range was limited, otherwise the entire base would have been frozen too.
A skill that could freeze Fallen ones could definitely freeze them to death too.
The first person to snap out of the shock was Commander Elizabeth.
She had not expected an 18-year-old boy to have such destructive power... from the moment he appeared in the battle, he had surprised them one after another.
And now even such a great surprise...
Who is he really?
Her sharp eyes scanned the battlefield in just a few seconds, and she immediately realized that this opportunity... was not permanent.
The Fallen ones were definitely not going to stay frozen forever, in the best case, and if they were lucky, they would probably stay frozen for a few minutes.
She shouted with all her might.
"All high-level forces! Attack right now!"
Her voice shook the entire base walls, all the commanders turned their heads at the same time.
The commander continued.
"The ice is not permanent!"
"They will only last a few minutes at most!"
"If we don’t use this opportunity now... when they break free, we will have to fight all over again!"
She pointed her sword toward the center of the field.
"The target is only the Fallen ones!"
"Leave the frozen monsters alone!"
"Kill the commanders first!"
Only a few seconds later... the massive gate of the Base opened for the first time since the siege began, and the heavy sound of metal gears echoed across the entire field.
Hundreds of high-level awakened ones poured out of the gate like a roaring flood, level 20 hunters.
Senior mages, elite swordsmen, and everyone who had been waiting for such an opportunity for more than a day, now charged into the heart of the field without the slightest hesitation.
This was an opportunity that was only going to be given to them once, an opportunity they had to use with all their being.
Commander Elizabeth was moving at the front of the line.
Her massive sword split one of the frozen Fallen ones in half with each strike.
On the other side... Kael activated dozens of magic circles at the same time, a rain of lightning fell on one of the Fallen ones and split its entire body.
Several other commanders also attacked from different directions, one of the Fallen ones did not even find a chance to break out of the ice.
Its arm, along with part of its shoulder, was severed.
Another, who had just managed to create a small crack in the ice, fell under a rain of swords.
The monster army had finally been completely destroyed, they had succeeded!
Shouts of victory rose from the walls, the defenders’ morale had been revived.
Although the biggest threat still remained...
But in the center of the field... none of these events mattered to the Abyssal River Drake.
Its massive body was calmly moving through the ice storm.
The ice that had trapped hundreds of monsters was being crushed under its weight, and its golden eyes did not look around even once.
All its attention... was only on one person.
Lian.
Or more precisely... what was inside his storage space.
The Devourer egg.
Its calm steps shook the ground, each step... was like a massive hammer blow.
The pressure of its presence was so heavy that even a few awakened ones nearby unconsciously stepped back.
At that same moment... Commander Elizabeth landed in front of Lian like a meteor.
The ground beneath her feet sank, three other commanders also appeared beside her almost at the same time.
One placed a shield as large as a gate in front of them, another created several defensive mana arrays.
Lian was lying on the ground like a half-dead man, he had no strength to move his muscles, all his mana had been drained.
All the damage he had endured with great difficulty had stopped healing due to his mana being drained, and he felt the pain with his entire being.
"Boy... you did excellently up to here." The commander said in a calm voice without even turning her head.
She stepped forward a few steps and raised her sword.
"The rest is with us."
The Drake showed no reaction, just... suddenly disappeared.
The commander only had time to raise her sword.
BOOOM!!
The sound of impact split the air.
Elizabeth was dragged dozens of meters on the ground, two other commanders hit stone pillars directly.
The massive shield of the fourth commander was shattered with just one strike of the Drake’s tail.
Deep cracks covered his entire shield, everyone was stunned.
The power of this monster... was completely different from all the Fallen ones they had seen so far.
Each strike of its tail was like a mountain hitting, each claw movement tore defensive arrays to pieces.
The commanders did not even find a chance to launch a full attack, but... at least they had managed to divert its attention away from Lian.
As soon as the pressure of the Drake’s presence was lifted from him... his entire body collapsed.
His legs could no longer bear his body weight, he tried to stand up but could not, and fell on one knee.
He placed his right hand on the ground to keep from falling, every breath was like thousands of needles piercing his chest.
His left arm was almost numb, blood was flowing down from the corner of his lips.
He truly felt his body had been pushed to the brink of destruction, even clenching his fist had become difficult for him.
"Lian!"
A familiar voice was heard from behind him, Kain rushed to him at full speed, ignoring the pain in his own body, he grabbed Lian’s arm to keep him from falling.
When he saw his friend’s condition, the color drained from his face, Lian’s armor was almost destroyed, his entire body was covered in wounds, even his breathing had become irregular.
But Lian, in that same state, gave a faint smile.
"I guess the siege is finally broken." He coughed for a moment and blood came out of his mouth.
Kain clenched his teeth in anger.
"Idiot... if you had been even a second later... you would be dead right now."
Lian did not answer, he just fixed his gaze on the battlefield, the battle of the four commanders with the Drake was becoming more violent every moment.
His main goal was to break the siege, which he had succeeded in doing, the entire monster army had been destroyed, and only their boss remained.
Right when many thought the situation might be improving... suddenly, one of the four commanders’ heads was severed and fell to the ground...
Fear was imprinted on everyone’s faces... and all the hope that had come was suddenly gone...
Maybe they had managed to destroy the monster army... but now they were facing a monster that was more powerful than the entire army.
"Damn it..." Elizabeth, level 37, who was still engaged with the Drake, whispered under her breath.
She barely deflected the monster’s claw strike and pulled herself aside.
She looked at the headless corpse of her friend lying on the ground, blood still flowing.
There was no time for mourning now... just a moment of distraction and she would be next!
At that same moment... the Abyssal River Drake raised its head toward the sky.
Its massive chest expanded and a terrifying roar shook the entire field.
A roar that even made the Base walls tremble from its intensity.
A second later... the ground began to shake again, as if it wanted to repeat the attack it had done a while ago, the attack that had caused the base’s defensive layers to collapse... again.
Elizabeth and the two remaining commanders noticed this and attacked with all their might to stop such a thing from happening.
"Wha... what is this?" We are right in the middle of this hell... suddenly, all the awakened ones felt multiple powerful presences approaching.
"Are more monsters coming?"
"My god! We are all going to die today!"
"Sob sob! More monsters? Are there still more?"
"Look! They are not monsters!"
From the distance, beyond the horizon... dozens... no... hundreds of powerful presences were approaching at high speed.
Moments later, a massive cloud of dust covered the sky in the distance.
Military flags appeared one after another from within the dust.
Massive armored caravans, tamed monsters with knights riding on their backs.
Chariots, mages, commanders, and thousands of fresh awakened ones.
Reinforcements and helps... had finally arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 162: The Calm After the Storm I
paragraphs: On the distant horizon, a massive cloud of dust was approaching the battlefield at an unusual speed.
At first, many thought a new wave of monsters was on the way.
But a few seconds later... flags emerged from within the dust.
Flags that did not belong to their Base.
Massive armored chariots, tamed monsters with knights riding on their backs, magical units, mana artillery, and thousands of fresh awakened ones, like a massive flood, were approaching the field.
In the Ruined Realms, each country built its own independent bases.
Each base had its own exclusive territory, safe routes, mana mines, ancient ruins, and valuable resources.
Sometimes these bases were rivals, fighting each other over newly discovered ruins.
They competed over rare resources, and political and military disputes had even formed between them many times.
But everyone knew one unwritten rule, the fall of a major base... was to the detriment of all humans.
Each base was considered part of the security chain of the explored areas.
If Base #3 fell, hundreds of kilometers of safe routes would once again become monster territory, and the pressure of that entire army would be divided among the surrounding bases.
No sensible commander would allow such a thing to happen.
For this reason, immediately after receiving the emergency message, the neighboring base had dispatched all its ready forces.

But unfortunately, the distance between the two bases was large, even if they moved at full speed, it would take at least a day for them to arrive, and that was only if they moved at full speed without considering the difficulty of their rides.
When they heard how bad the situation was and realized they had no choice, that was exactly what they did.
At the front of that army, a tall man with dark blue armor and a gray cloak was standing.
He held a long spear in his hand, from the tip of which dense mana waves were leaking out.
His eyes were calm but piercing, his name... Valerian Cross, a level 40 awakened one who was only half a step away from his second evolution.
The main commander of the base that had come to help them.
All along the way, he had imagined he would be facing a widespread but normal siege.
But right when his gaze fell on the massive monster fighting in the center of the field... his face became completely serious.
And the system notification appeared for him.
[ Abyssal River Drake ]
[ Rank: Fallen ]
[ Level: 35 ]
Valerian stared at the information for a few seconds without speaking, then his gaze fixed on the monster itself again.
The body of that creature... did not fully match the information on the screen.
The mana pressure emanating from its body was even greater than many level 45 monsters.
Its black scales, the red veins among them, its unusual bloodline, and its innate skills had made the gap between the numbers almost meaningless.
He quietly whispered under his breath.
"The report only said a Fallen one was commanding the army." He paused for a few seconds.
"No one mentioned we would be facing a monster like this..." A level 35 Fallen... even he alone had no chance of defeating such a monster.
The monster also turned its head toward the newly arrived army at that same moment, its golden eyes fixed on Valerian for a moment.
Two hunters assessed each other.
Valerian dismounted from his riding monster without a moment’s hesitation.
Three commanders, level 33, level 34, and level 35, also landed beside him.
They moved directly toward the main battlefield, at that same moment, the Abyssal River Drake charged back toward Lian with explosive speed.
As if it did not want to miss the slightest opportunity and wanted to reach its target as soon as possible, it had to get that egg back by any means necessary!
But before it could cover the distance... Valerian’s spear fell from the sky like lightning.
BOOOM!!
The monster’s massive claw collided with the tip of the spear, a massive shockwave spread across the entire field.
The ground sank dozens of meters, several nearby monsters were thrown into the air even without being the target of the attack.
The monster stepped back one step.
Valerian also slid a few meters on the ground, but held his spear firmly, a faint smile settled on his face.
"Your power is truly absurd..."
At that same moment, Elizabeth also landed beside him, her armor was broken in several places, and blood was flowing from the side of her forehead.
And her gaze was still fixed on the corpse of the commander who had lost his head a few moments ago.
Valerian gave her a quick look.
"I need all your help to kill this creature."
Elizabeth, without taking her gaze off the Drake, wiped the blood from the corner of her lips and then said in a quiet voice.
"No problem." Her eyes fixed on her fallen comrade for a moment.
"I also have to avenge my soldiers."
A few moments of silence passed between them, years of competition, years of disagreement, but now... none of that mattered.
Both knew that if this monster survived... no base in this region would be safe.
The newly arrived commanders immediately took formation.
Defensive mages created several layers of mana shields around the field, high-level spearmen and swordsmen surrounded the Drake from different directions.
The mana artillery also started firing one after another.
For the first time... the Abyssal River Drake itself was surrounded.
Around it... Valerian Cross, Elizabeth, and five other commanders.
Dozens of level 20 and above awakened ones, and hundreds of support forces, the numerical advantage... was now with the humans.
But no one was happy, everyone could feel the terrifying pressure of that creature.
The Abyssal River Drake slowly turned its head.
Its gaze passed through the commanders and fixed on Lian again, it let out a roar that shook the entire field.
In its roar, there was only one emotion, rage... pure rage.
It moved toward Lian again, although Valerian appeared in its path once more.
His long spear blocked the attack path, at the same time Elizabeth attacked from the left flank, and several mana chains wrapped around the monster’s massive legs.
The Drake tore them apart with one movement, but those few seconds were enough.
It was forced to focus all its attention on the enemies in front of it, there was no longer a way to reach Lian directly.
Kain placed Lian’s arm over his shoulder, almost all his weight had fallen on his body.
"Move."
Lian blinked with difficulty, he could still hear the sound of explosions, he turned his head a few times.
He saw Valerian and Elizabeth’s battle with the Drake, and then took a deep breath.
"For now... they don’t need me anymore..."
"Stop talking, just try to stay alive." Kain said angrily.
Lian just gave a faint smile, even that smile made blood flow from the corner of his lips.
When they reached near the base gate... Seraphina was the first to see them, and at that same moment, she ran at full speed.
But when she saw Lian’s condition... all the color drained from her face, her body froze for a few seconds, and then she said with a trembling voice.
"...Lian? Damn it! Damn it! You didn’t have to do all that!" Seeing her childhood friend’s face like this was hard for her.
She always knew he was stubborn, but not to the point of putting himself in such danger! If help had arrived just a little later, Lian would be dead right now!
What if that damn monster had killed Lian? Why doesn’t this idiot care about himself at all? Why does he put himself in such danger?
"It’s nothing serious..." Lian tried to smile.
Seraphina almost shouted:
"That’s not something someone whose half his body is crushed and broken should say!" Her eyes were full of worry.
It was as if she was even afraid of the thought that they might have arrived a few minutes later.

No sarcasm, no jokes, she just stared at Lian’s condition for a few seconds, even she had to admit that this robber had made a huge contribution this time.
Without his help, the base might have really fallen... maybe all of them would have been killed.
Bren came forward without a word and took his weight, Elias spent his last remaining mana on emergency treatment.
"We need to get him to the medical center first." Kael said with a completely serious face.

"Go... bring that prisoner."
Everyone was silent for a moment.
"Prisoner?" Seraphina frowned.
"What are you talking about?" Kael also asked in surprise.
They were not aware of the situation, and it was normal that they did not know what Lian was talking about, but Kain just nodded without any explanation.
"Got it." And immediately ran toward the rocks where he had hidden the native prisoner.
No one asked more questions, from Lian’s face, it was clear that the matter... was much more important than they imagined, but his condition did not look good enough to explain anything.
As they were passing through the gate... suddenly Lian’s storage space trembled.
Once.
Twice.
Then stronger, and a blue notification appeared before his eyes.
[ Devourer Detects Abundant Biomass ]
[ Hunger Intensifying ]
The egg’s pulse was getting faster every moment.
Lian unconsciously looked at the battlefield, thousands of corpses and killed monsters... all of them could be excellent food for the Devourer.
But... now? Impossible.
Thousands of people were around him, if he took the egg out right now... everything would be over, and his great secret would no longer remain a secret.
Besides, God knew how that monster would react if it suddenly saw the egg, who knew if it would suddenly go crazy and be willing to destroy everyone along with itself to get that egg back?
Only a madman would take that egg out right now.
There would be plenty of opportunities later to feed this egg, even if he had to buy the monster corpses, but for now, this was not the time.
But the egg was still pulsing, stronger, greedier, and as if the creature inside it... was frantically smelling all this blood and flesh.
When Lian passed through the Base gate... his mind calmed down.
Kain was alive, the native prisoner was on his way, reinforcements had arrived, and powerful commanders had stopped the Drake.
His body no longer had a reason to resist, and suddenly he heard Seraphina’s voice from a distance.
"Lian..."
"Lian, keep your eyes open..."
But the image in front of him slowly blurred, his legs could no longer stand, and before he fell to the ground, Bren and Kain caught him.
The last thing he felt before his eyes completely closed... was the fast and hungry pulse of the Devourer egg in his storage space.
And then... everything fell into darkness.

sentences.text: On the distant horizon, a massive cloud of dust was approaching the battlefield at an unusual speed.
At first, many thought a new wave of monsters was on the way.
But a few seconds later... flags emerged from within the dust.
Flags that did not belong to their Base.
Massive armored chariots, tamed monsters with knights riding on their backs, magical units, mana artillery, and thousands of fresh awakened ones, like a massive flood, were approaching the field.
In the Ruined Realms, each country built its own independent bases.
Each base had its own exclusive territory, safe routes, mana mines, ancient ruins, and valuable resources.
Sometimes these bases were rivals, fighting each other over newly discovered ruins.
They competed over rare resources, and political and military disputes had even formed between them many times.
But everyone knew one unwritten rule, the fall of a major base... was to the detriment of all humans.
Each base was considered part of the security chain of the explored areas.
If Base #3 fell, hundreds of kilometers of safe routes would once again become monster territory, and the pressure of that entire army would be divided among the surrounding bases.
No sensible commander would allow such a thing to happen.
For this reason, immediately after receiving the emergency message, the neighboring base had dispatched all its ready forces.

But unfortunately, the distance between the two bases was large, even if they moved at full speed, it would take at least a day for them to arrive, and that was only if they moved at full speed without considering the difficulty of their rides.
When they heard how bad the situation was and realized they had no choice, that was exactly what they did.
At the front of that army, a tall man with dark blue armor and a gray cloak was standing.
He held a long spear in his hand, from the tip of which dense mana waves were leaking out.
His eyes were calm but piercing, his name...
Valerian Cross, a level 40 awakened one who was only half a step away from his second evolution.
The main commander of the base that had come to help them.
All along the way, he had imagined he would be facing a widespread but normal siege.
But right when his gaze fell on the massive monster fighting in the center of the field... his face became completely serious.
And the system notification appeared for him.
[ Abyssal River Drake ]
[ Rank: Fallen ]
[ Level: 35 ]
Valerian stared at the information for a few seconds without speaking, then his gaze fixed on the monster itself again.
The body of that creature... did not fully match the information on the screen.
The mana pressure emanating from its body was even greater than many level 45 monsters.
Its black scales, the red veins among them, its unusual bloodline, and its innate skills had made the gap between the numbers almost meaningless.
He quietly whispered under his breath.
"The report only said a Fallen one was commanding the army." He paused for a few seconds.
"No one mentioned we would be facing a monster like this..." A level 35 Fallen... even he alone had no chance of defeating such a monster.
The monster also turned its head toward the newly arrived army at that same moment, its golden eyes fixed on Valerian for a moment.
Two hunters assessed each other.
Valerian dismounted from his riding monster without a moment’s hesitation.
Three commanders, level 33, level 34, and level 35, also landed beside him.
They moved directly toward the main battlefield, at that same moment, the Abyssal River Drake charged back toward Lian with explosive speed.
As if it did not want to miss the slightest opportunity and wanted to reach its target as soon as possible, it had to get that egg back by any means necessary!
But before it could cover the distance...
Valerian’s spear fell from the sky like lightning.
BOOOM!!
The monster’s massive claw collided with the tip of the spear, a massive shockwave spread across the entire field.
The ground sank dozens of meters, several nearby monsters were thrown into the air even without being the target of the attack.
The monster stepped back one step.
Valerian also slid a few meters on the ground, but held his spear firmly, a faint smile settled on his face.
"Your power is truly absurd..."
At that same moment, Elizabeth also landed beside him, her armor was broken in several places, and blood was flowing from the side of her forehead.
And her gaze was still fixed on the corpse of the commander who had lost his head a few moments ago.
Valerian gave her a quick look.
"I need all your help to kill this creature."
Elizabeth, without taking her gaze off the Drake, wiped the blood from the corner of her lips and then said in a quiet voice.
"No problem." Her eyes fixed on her fallen comrade for a moment.
"I also have to avenge my soldiers."
A few moments of silence passed between them, years of competition, years of disagreement, but now... none of that mattered.
Both knew that if this monster survived... no base in this region would be safe.
The newly arrived commanders immediately took formation.
Defensive mages created several layers of mana shields around the field, high-level spearmen and swordsmen surrounded the Drake from different directions.
The mana artillery also started firing one after another.
For the first time... the Abyssal River Drake itself was surrounded.

Valerian Cross, Elizabeth, and five other commanders.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: The Calm After the Storm II
paragraphs: With Lian losing consciousness, the battlefield did not stop, but instead reached its bloodiest moments.
The Abyssal River Drake stared for a few moments in the direction where Lian had been taken.
Its golden eyes were shining like two burning suns.
It could sense the presence of the Devourer egg, but now dozens of powerful humans were standing between it and its target.
A deep roar came from its chest, suddenly all the red veins on its body lit up.
First one... then dozens of veins, and then its entire massive body, the sound of scales cracking echoed across the field.
Cracks formed between the black scales, and red energy burst out from within them; energy that even burned the air.
The monster’s mana pressure suddenly multiplied several times, the soil beneath its feet melted, and red winds around its body turned into a vortex.
[ Abyssal River Drake has entered Berserk state ]
As a Fallen one, it was normal for this monster to have a berserk state.
But this was not something the awakened ones were happy to see, instead their frowns and worries multiplied.
Even until now, they had barely been able to gain an advantage over this monster, and now it had entered that damn berserk state?
But besides being very bad news, it was also good news, because it meant that now less than ten percent of this monster’s health bar remained.
"...Berserk." One of the level 31 commanders whispered with a pale face.
Valerian also held his spear tighter.
"Everyone keep your distance!" But his warning was late.
BOOOM!
The Drake disappeared like lightning, and the next moment, one of the level 32 commanders had no chance to react.

A massive claw passed through his mana shield, the shield shattered, the armor split, and the commander’s body was thrown into the air like a rag doll, and after hitting the ground, it did not move again.
And another awakened one had lost his life...
At the same time, the monster’s massive tail spun like a deadly whip, three level 20+ awakened ones did not even have a chance to scream.
Their bodies fell several dozen meters away on the ground.
The Drake no longer had any trace of reason or restraint, every attack was only for killing.
Valerian brought his spear down with all his might, the spear hit the monster’s neck with a deafening sound.
The scales broke, but at the same moment, the Drake’s claw also hit Valerian’s shoulder.
The sound of bones breaking was heard, and Valerian was dragged dozens of meters on the ground, and even his S-rank spear cracked.
Blood flowed from the corner of his lips, and he got up with heavy breaths.
"Really... you damn monster..." He was not lying if he said that this damn Fallen one in front of him was the strongest monster he had ever fought.
On the other side of the field, Elizabeth lost her last mana shield, the monster’s claw split her shield in half, and the pieces of the shield scattered on the ground.
She was forced to hold her sword with both hands, but despite all the pressure... no one retreated.
This time the situation was different, the humans had the numerical advantage, and the mages from behind the field were continuously casting buffs and debuffs.
The mana artillery was firing without stopping, and the close-range units also did not give the monster a chance to breathe every time it attacked.
Only less than ten percent of this damn monster’s health bar remained, if they continued like this, they could finally kill it.
And finally, that is exactly what happened.
Slowly... the Drake’s massive body became covered in wounds.
Dark red blood flowed from the broken scales, one of its horns broke, its right claw was wounded, and its breaths became heavier than before.
Valerian suddenly smiled.
"Now is the time..."
Elizabeth understood what he meant, she attacked from the left flank at full speed, her sword hit the Drake’s leg, and the monster’s balance was disrupted for only a fraction of a second.
That one moment was enough, the mages shouted.
"The chains!"
Dozens of mana chains emerged from the ground, this time not one... but several mages had activated them simultaneously.
The monster’s massive legs were locked for a moment, and the level 30+ commanders attacked from three different directions at the same time.
The Drake roared and threw two of them with its tail, but that delay... was Valerian’s opportunity.
He poured all his remaining mana into his spear, the spear began to shine, the mana pressure was so high that the ground around him cracked.
His voice echoed across the entire field.
"Heaven Piercing Lance!"
The next moment... the spear split the sky like a column of blue light, its speed was so high that no one could see its movement.
Only... the sound of flesh being torn, the spear passed through the Drake’s right eye, shattered its skull, and came out from the back of its head.
The monster remained completely still for a few seconds, let out a roar that was heard for kilometers around.
Then... its massive body slowly leaned forward and with a sound that shook the ground... fell on the plain.
Silence... a heavy silence covered everything.
Then... shouts of victory rose from all the walls of the Base.
"We won!"
"We killed the commander!"
"We survived!"
Some awakened ones sat down on the ground right there, some were crying, some were just staring at the monster’s massive corpse.
The war... was finally over.
At that same moment, blue system windows appeared before the eyes of all the Base members.
[ Emergency Quest Completed ]
[ Base #3 Successfully Defended ]
[ Rewards Obtained ]
[ +10 Fragments ]
[ +100 Stat Points ]
[ +1 Level ]
A few seconds later, another notification appeared.
[ Quest Rewards Reduced ]
[ Reason: External Military Intervention Detected. ]
A few people looked at the notification in surprise, one of the senior officers sighed.
"The main reward was two hundred and fifty Stat Points."
Some turned back in disbelief.
And he continued.
"That’s the system’s rule, if the base completes the Quest on its own, it receives the full reward."
"But when external forces play a role in completing the mission... part of the reward is deducted."
Everyone nodded, no one complained, if the reinforcements had not arrived... there would be no base or life left to receive any reward.
Even now, their casualties were high, and those who had survived were truly lucky.
Besides, even though the Quest reward had been reduced, everyone knew that the government was going to give them large financial rewards for today.
On the other side of the field, a few of Valerian’s forces were looking around in surprise.
"We didn’t get anything?"
"The notification didn’t appear for us."
Valerian also closed his empty system screen and gave a calm smile.
"It’s natural, this Quest belonged to Base #3, we only came to help."
No one else said anything, but disappointment could be seen on their faces, saving lives was a good deed, but they would have been happier if they had received a reward for it too.
A few minutes later... Kain entered the base with the native prisoner.
The native was still unconscious, but that was enough for whispers to spread everywhere.
"A human?"
"Really a human? He doesn’t look familiar? Where is he from?"
"What is that armor he’s wearing?"
"A native?"
"Impossible..."
"Does this world still have humans?
Less than ten minutes later... the entire base had heard the news.
Valerian and Elizabeth personally came to where the prisoner was being held, both looked at the white-robed man’s face for a few moments without speaking.
Valerian was the first to break the silence.
"Where did you find him?"
"In an ancient ruin, and not me, Lian captured him." Kain answered quietly.
Both commanders were silent for a moment.
"That same boy again..." Elizabeth whispered under her breath.
"Lian? Who is he?" Valerian frowned.
"The hero of this base." Then without exaggeration, she summarized the events of the past few hours.
From destroying a large part of the monster army, and finally... to holding the Abyssal River Drake until the reinforcements arrived.
The more she explained... the more serious Valerian’s face became, and at the end, he just said quietly.
"All of this... was done by an eighteen-year-old boy? If that’s true... his talent is truly monstrous." He thought for a few moments and then added.
"I want to meet him personally later."
"He’s in the medical center for now, he hasn’t woken up yet." Elizabeth answered.
"Then we should deal with this native matter first." Their gazes fell on the native again.
Two days passed.
The war was over, but the medical center was still busy, hundreds of wounded were being treated.
In one of the quiet rooms... Lian was lying on a special treatment bed.
His body was almost completely bandaged, healing crystals were slowly infusing mana into his body.
Next to the bed... Seraphina was sitting on a chair, over the past two days, she had come almost every few hours to check on his condition.
Most of the time, she had stayed there.
At that moment, the door opened and Kain entered.
"Are you feeling better?" Seraphina looked at him and asked, she knew Kain’s condition was not good either, and something had happened to him out there.
"Yeah, my wounds were nothing compared to him." Kain gave a faint smile.
"So you found that ruin, huh?" The girl asked curiously.
Kain nodded and then told the story of the ruin, about finding it, about the two native humans, about being wounded, and how Lian had arrived in time and saved him.
But about the sacred spring... the class upgrade... the race change... and the title Born of Light... he did not say even a single word.
That secret... for now, would remain only between him and Lian, and when he finished...
"A native human..." Seraphina said quietly, she still found it hard to believe.
"So this realm might really be different from all the previous ones." And a few moments later, she asked.
"Besides that... did you find anything special inside the ruin?"
Kain shrugged.
"I’m not sure, Lian took a few treasures, but we haven’t looked at them yet."
"So the ruin wasn’t that special..." Seraphina sighed.
Kain laughed.
"Why are you disappointed? The three races that had closed off the area are gone."
"After things calm down completely, we can explore up to a thousand kilometer radius and even further."
"That’s when the real and cooler ruins will start."
Seraphina also smiled quietly, maybe... the main adventure was just on the verge of beginning.
The morning of the third day...
Sunlight was coming through the window into the room, a quiet calm had covered everything.
Lian’s fingers moved slightly, then his hand trembled, his eyelids slowly opened.
The image in front of him was blurry at first, but gradually became clear.
The first thing he saw... was Seraphina, her head resting on the edge of the bed, she had fallen asleep there from exhaustion.
He was finally awake...
