A Worker turned its head toward him, it hadn’t even completed half of its movement when Lian landed on its back.
He brought down his ice claw, the connection point between the head and body was split open.
The ant collapsed.
Lian jumped to the left before the corpse hit the ground.
The second ant had opened its jaws, he struck the inner part of the jaw with his knee.
The creature’s head was deflected, and then the Glacial Reaper Claw went straight into one of its eyes.
The ice spread from inside its head, the movement of its legs stopped at that very moment.
The third ant raised its abdomen, the red stinger shot out from the end of its body.
Lian saw it, he could dodge, but he didn’t.
The tip of the stinger hit his shoulder with all its force.
The sound of the impact was like a steel nail hitting a rock, a small spark jumped from the contact point, and the skin on Lian’s shoulder became transparent and dark for a moment.
[Diamond Skin]
The stinger could not even scratch the surface of his skin.
The ant remained motionless for a moment, as if even the monster was shocked.
As if they had doubted whether they were prey or predators.
Lian turned his head toward it.
The creature might not be able to feel fear, but its antennae suddenly moved with agitation.
He wrapped his hand around the end part of its abdomen, planted his feet firmly on the ground.
Then he lifted the entire several-hundred-kilogram body of the ant off the ground.
Ravian was watching in disbelief.
The muscles of Lian’s arm and shoulder contracted under his clothes, he swung the ant’s body in the air and violently slammed it into one of its kind.
The sound of shells breaking echoed in the space, both creatures fell to the ground.
One of them was still moving.
Lian landed on its head and with one kick, crushed the front part of its shell.
The remaining ants did not attack directly this time.
Instead, they tightened the circle.
Six Workers and four Soldiers came out from the moss.
Their legs moved on the ground with strange order, their antennae went up and down at the same time.
They had seen the previous attacks, now they wanted to apply pressure from all sides.
Lian took a calm breath, the ice claw on his hand cracked.
But it was still not destroyed.
He looked around, the distance between the enemies, the slope of the ground, the thickness of the moss, and the positions of Ravian, Sera, and Nemi.
Everything came together in his mind in an instant.
Then he knelt down, placed his free palm on the ground.
Mana moved under his skin.
It went down from his shoulder, passed through his arm, gathered in his palm, and for a moment, the soil beneath his fingers sank.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
The explosion had no sound.
First, only a heavy impact came from within the ground, then a compressed wave spread in all directions.
The moss was uprooted, and the soil rose in a ring around Lian.
The shell on the underside of the ants’ abdomen, where their armor was thinner, cracked under the wave’s pressure.
A few Workers were thrown into the air, one of the Soldiers fell on its side and its legs kicked aimlessly in the air.
The encirclement formation was broken in an instant, and Lian jumped out from the dust of the soil.
The first ant was still trying to turn around when Glacial Reaper Claw passed under its jaw.
The second one lost its balance with a direct hit to the front leg joint.
Lian stepped on its shell, climbed up, and sank the claw into the back of its head.
The third one prepared its stinger.
Lian grabbed it, pulled the creature’s body toward himself, and crushed its forehead with a knee strike.
The fourth and fifth attacked at the same time.
Lian spun between them, one’s jaw passed by his side, his claw passed through the other’s chest.
Then with a short kick, he threw the first ant into a small crack between two roots.
The sound of its body hitting the rock was heard, it did not move anymore.
The battle had turned into a slaughter, not one of those fights where the result was uncertain.
A one-sided massacre of giant monsters.
And Ravian, Sera, and Nemi were watching in shock, and were slowly becoming sure that Lian might be more powerful than all the hunters of their tribe.
What kind of monster were they bringing to their tribe?

chapters.title: Chapter 198: The Colony Of Ants I
paragraphs: No, this was not a battle where Lian had to use all his power to survive.
It was only clearing creatures whose levels were below the point where they could truly hurt him.
The ants ran, attacked, and stung.
But every time, Predator’s Instincts warned him before they moved.
Night Eyes showed their path even in the darkest parts of the moss.
Diamond Skin made every hit he deliberately received useless.
And Glacial Reaper Claw broke their hard shells like thin crust.
The last Crimson Needle Soldier stepped back.
Level 24.
The largest creature of the group.
Its chest shell was thicker than the others, and its long stinger was dripping a green and dark liquid on the ground.
The creature moved its antennae, then suddenly turned around, intending to escape, as if fear had entered it.
Lian did not allow it, he took a step, the soil beneath his foot split, and the next moment he appeared behind the ant.
The ice claw came down from above, the sound of breaking shell echoed in the forest, and the Level 24 body moved two more steps forward.
Then it fell on the ground.
Silence returned, the surrounding moss was covered in dark blood, layers of ice had formed on the corpses.
The legs of a few ants were still twitching with weak movements, but none of them were considered a threat anymore.
Lian stood up straight.
The dark veins on his neck returned to normal, Glacial Reaper Claw cracked on his hand and turned into ice particles.
The entire battle had lasted less than two minutes.
His breathing was slightly heavier, not more than that, and behind him, the three Lacerians were still holding their weapons up.
None of them had had the chance to land even one hit.
Nemi was looking at the bodies with a half-open mouth.
Then at Lian, and then back at the bodies.
"You killed all of them... alone?"
Lian bent down and examined the broken stinger of one of the Soldiers, the green liquid at its tip was still bubbling.
"They were too weak." For him, that explanation was enough, despite their large size, all of them were below level 25.
But the silence that followed his sentence showed that it was not the same for those three.
Ravian slowly lowered his spear, his gaze still fixed on Lian.
"You really come from that world you said? Are all people of your species this strong?"
"It depends, some are stronger and some are weaker." Lian answered calmly, and then the system panels appeared before his eyes one after another.
[You killed Crimson Needle Worker — Level 18.]
[Butcher activated.]
[A fraction of the target’s stats has been permanently acquired.]
The next message appeared.
[You killed Crimson Needle Soldier — Level 22.]
[Butcher activated.]
[A fraction of the target’s stats has been permanently acquired.]
A few more messages came one after another, Lian ignored them without much attention, the gain from each was small.
But their number made that big difference, with a general look, he realized he had obtained 192 stats points, and there was another happy piece of news.
His level bar was almost full, and he was not far from level 17.
Then a different message appeared.
[Glutton activated.]
[Skill detected.]
[Paralytic Venom]
[Absorption in progress...]
[Absorption successful.]
[New Skill acquired: Paralytic Effect.]
[Rank: Common ( + )]

[Description: Your body fluids can be poisonous and deadly for targets. The weaker the enemy, the more deadly the poison. The closer the target’s power is to you, or the stronger they are, the weaker the poison acts. Each drop of poison consumes 0.001 mana.]
Lian opened and closed his fingers.
For a moment, a very thin layer of green liquid formed on the tips of his nails and then disappeared.
He immediately understood the meaning of the change.
From now on, every scratch or wound he inflicted would contain poison and could either kill or weaken his enemies.
Maybe it would not fully work on powerful monsters, but even slowing a movement by half a second in a real fight could be the difference between life and death.
Sera approached one of the corpses and touched its shell with the tip of her knife.
"You even split the Soldier’s armor." Surprise was visible in her eyes, this Otherworldly’s power was insane.
"The underside of their stomach is weaker." Lian said.
"That’s not what I meant." Sera raised her head, even if they knew the weak points, they could not kill such a monster.
Except for the tribe chief and the elders, there was no other hunter in their tribe who could hunt even one of these monsters alone.
Let alone slaughter a whole group of them alone.
And this Otherworldly looked as young as them... unless she was mistaken, how could such a young creature be so powerful?
If every person in their world was that powerful... then their world was in great danger!
Before Lian could answer, the ground trembled, not like before, this time stronger, much stronger, and the ant corpses shook on the soil.
Pieces of ice fell from their shells.
Ravian immediately raised his head, Nemi stepped back.
The second impact came, and one of the corpses was lifted off the ground and fell again.
Then a massive shadow covered the entire area, the green light of the forest disappeared, everyone looked up.
First they saw the horns, not two simple horns, but a massive network of bone branches that moved like a dry crown in the mist.
Then the creature’s head appeared, a long and heavy face, eyes the size of shields, and dark skin with golden veins.
The monster’s body passed through the trees, and the height of its shoulders reached over thirty meters.
The identification panel appeared for a moment.
[Titan Horned Elk]
[Level: 31]
The creature was coming straight toward them.
Nemi held her breath, Sera raised her weapon.
"Don’t move." Ravian said.
Lian kept his gaze fixed on the creature’s massive legs.
Had it seen them? Had the smell of the ants’ blood attracted it?
The Titan Horned Elk did not lower its head, its eyes passed over their heads.
Not on them, but on a bush dozens of meters away, they did not exist for it, the creature’s front leg lifted.
The shadow of its sole fell on the ant corpses.
A moment later, the foot landed, the sound of the impact was like a falling boulder, half of the battle scene disappeared under its sole.
A few Crimson Needle Ant corpses, broken shells, and layers of ice, turned into a dark paste in an instant.
A wave of soil scattered around.
Lian was forced to raise his arm in front of his face.
The Titan Horned Elk took its next step without stopping.
Its other leg passed a few meters beside them, the wind from its movement shook their clothes.
Then its massive body passed over their heads, the smell of soil, plants, and animal filled the surrounding space.
A few seconds later, the monster moved further away, every step still shaking the forest.
It never looked back, all the battle that had shocked Ravian and his two companions moments before...
All that speed, power, and slaughter, for this forest, was nothing more than a few insects being crushed under the foot of a large herbivore.
Lian looked at the creature’s fresh footprint, the pit was several meters deep, the ants’ blood had pooled at the bottom.
He was an absolute predator for creatures below Level 25.
A monster that could slaughter them without help, without fear, and almost without damage.
But the Forest of Giants... had a different scale.
Here, there was always something bigger, something that might not even sense his presence.
He looked at the corpses of the monsters he had killed, only three of them had remained intact, and he took those three without hesitation and placed them in his storage space.
"We have to go." Ravian finally let out his breath.
"I agree, if a monster like that notices us, it will be bad." Lian took his gaze off the footprint.
"No, the main problem is not the other monsters." Ravian shook his head.
He looked at the pit and the monsters’ blood.
"It’s because of these ants that we have to leave this place as soon as possible." And then he added.
"They are dead, but that is the problem."
"Crimson Needle Ants don’t hunt only by smell. When one of the colony members dies, its body releases a substance that alerts the rest."
"The rest?" Lian frowned, a bad guess appeared in his mind, and just to be sure, he asked.
"The colony." Ravian looked at him.
And his guess was correct, they had to leave this place right now! He could probably handle dozens of them.
But facing hundreds or thousands of them would be hard and even impossible for him.
At that same moment, Sera lowered her head, as if she had heard something, she walked a few steps forward and knelt down.
She put her ear near the ground, remained motionless for a few seconds, and then her face lost its color.
"Ravian..."
A very faint rustling sound was heard from a distance, at first it sounded like rain falling on leaves, but there was no rain.
The sound became more regular.
Tick tick tick tick tick tick.
Thousands of small impacts.
Thousands of feet.
The distant moss moved, not in one spot but across a wide area, a wave of movement formed in the green cover and slowly approached them.
Hundreds of red eyes opened in the darkness under the moss, then their number increased.
Dozens.
Hundreds.
Maybe thousands.
Lian looked carefully, each one alone was weak, each one below Level 25, he could kill one.
Kill ten, maybe even a hundred.
But not before their numbers covered the entire ground, not before they climbed over each other and filled every gap.
Not before Sera, Ravian, and Nemi disappeared under a wave of armored bodies.
"We have to reach the bitter mushroom path." Ravian immediately stood up, urgency and fear were completely noticeable in his voice.
"Where is it?" Lian also understood the urgency of the matter.
"Based on the signs, the direction of the wind, and the sun’s path, it should be about two kilometers away from us, their smell will hide our trail." Ravian pointed to the left.
Lian looked at the wave of moving moss, this boy really had a good talent for tracking.
And two kilometers in this forest was not a short distance, two kilometers in this forest was like two thousand kilometers, and God knew what other threats might exist on their path.
But there was no other choice.
"Run!" Ravian shouted.
The four started moving, Sera and Nemi ran ahead, Ravian behind them was clearing the path.
Lian ran a few steps, but then stopped, for a moment he looked back, now he could see the red and black heads among the moss.
An endless row, the further they came, the more the moss split open.
The ground was no longer still, the entire forest floor... was moving.
A whole colony was coming after them!

chapters.title: Chapter 199: The Colony Of Ants II
paragraphs: The entire forest floor was moving.
Not metaphorically, and not because of the ground trembling.
The moss itself, the rotten leaves, and the dark layers of soil were rippling under the pressure of thousands of red and black bodies.
Crimson Needle Ants were pouring out from the darkness and advancing like a living flood among the massive roots.

Their antennae were twitching wildly, their metal jaws were clicking together with a dry and regular sound, and their countless legs were striking the ground so hard that the sound resembled heavy rain falling on thousands of roofs.
Ravian was running at the front.
He kept his body low, and with every step, he thrust his spear into the moss and thick stems to clear the path.
The spear’s tip hit narrow roots several times, and green sparks of mana jumped from the wood’s surface, but he did not slow down even for a moment.
Sera was holding her wounded shoulder with one hand and pulling Nemi with the other.

The wound under the wrapped cloth had opened again. Blood was running down from the edge of the cloth and making a thin line on her arm, but the pressure of the ants’ feet behind them left no time to stop.
Nemi’s foot got caught in the moss several times.
Each time, Sera pulled her forward.
Lian was running at the back of the group, a position he had deliberately chosen.
From there, he could see the wave of ants, estimate the distance, and eliminate any creature that got too close to his companions.
Predator’s Instincts was working in his mind like a continuous alarm.
Danger was approaching from behind, very close, but not only from behind.
There was also a vague pressure from the front; weaker, more hidden, and at the same time more uncertain, Lian took his gaze off the ants every few seconds and checked the path ahead.
Tangled roots, short mushrooms, dark hollows, practically nothing clear could be seen.
Nevertheless, the unpleasant feeling did not disappear.
"Just run to the bitter mushroom path! Once we enter their mist, the ants will lose our trail!" Ravian shouted without turning his head.
His voice was almost lost under the roar of thousands of feet, Lian looked at the wave behind them.
The first row of ants was now less than fifty meters away.
A few Workers were thinner than the rest and were crossing over the backs of their kind with unusual speed.
One of them jumped out from the moss and leaped high toward Sera.
Lian changed his path without stopping, cold mana gathered around his right hand, the air’s moisture turned white in an instant, and a layer of dark ice formed around his fingers.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
The ice claw extended along his fingers, the ant was still in the air when Lian passed by it.
A cold and dark line passed through the creature’s body, the Worker was split into two parts in the air.
The two halves of its body fell on the moss a few meters away, and its dark blood turned into ice crystals before it could fully spill.
The second ant approached from the left.
Lian spun, his heel hit the side of the creature’s head directly, and the sound of shell breaking like stone shattering was heard.
The ant’s body was slammed against the root wall and sank deep into the moss.
The third jumped from behind him, Lian ducked at the last moment, the metal jaws passed over his head, and he grabbed the front part of the ant’s body with both hands.
With a spin, he lifted the entire several-hundred-kilogram body of the monster and threw it toward the wave behind him.
The ant’s living body fell like a boulder among the advancing ranks.
A few Workers collided with it, some fell, but only a second later, dozens of ants climbed over their bodies and continued moving.
Lian frowned, every monster he killed only created a space the size of one step.
Behind that space, dozens of other bodies were moving, their numbers were so great that killing them was like trying to empty a river with bare hands.
His effort was practically useless.
Just how many of these bastards were there?
"We’re close!" Ravian jumped over a short root.
The group climbed up behind him.
Lian was the last one, before crossing the root, three more ants came up from behind.
He passed Glacial Reaper Claw through the first one’s jaw, slammed the second one’s head into the ground with his elbow, and kicked the third one back into the wave.
But the pressure from behind was increasing every moment, the sound of feet was no longer just heard, it was felt in the bones.
The ground trembled beneath their steps, and the tall moss on both sides of the path bent like grass under a flood.
Suddenly, Ravian stopped.
Lian almost hit his back, in front of them, a massive gap had opened its mouth.
Two giant roots had separated in the past, and the space between them had turned into a deep valley.
The walls of the gap were covered with small mushrooms and hanging roots, but its bottom disappeared into complete darkness.
No sound came from the bottom of the gap, no stones hitting, no water flowing, as if the gap had no end.
The only way to cross was a dry and thick stem that had fallen from one side of the gap to the other.
Compared to them, the stem looked like a narrow tree trunk, but its surface was full of cracks, and parts of it seemed rotten.
"Is this part of the plan too?" Sera gave her brother a tired look.
How were they supposed to get across this damn path?
Ravian only took one look behind them, the wave of ants was now coming over the previous root.
"We have no other choice." He stepped onto the stem without pausing, the wood groaned under his weight. He kept his balance and crossed the gap quickly.
When he reached the other side, he turned back and kept his spear ready.
"Nemi, you first!"
The younger sister hesitated and was worried about falling, but when she looked behind her, she realized she had no other choice.
She sighed, and Nemi stepped onto the stem.
Her feet slipped on the first step, but Sera held her hand from behind, and the two moved forward carefully.
Lian remained on the previous side, the first Crimson Needle Worker jumped down from the root.
Then the second.
Then a large Soldier with a thick shell appeared among them.
Lian stood in front of the bridge.
None of them should get past him, if even two or three ants stepped onto the stem, their weight would be enough to break it.
Electrical energy began to move in his veins, a tingling feeling went down from his shoulders and gathered in his palms.
The air around his fingers cracked, thin blue and white lightning jumped between his nails.
[Thunder Calamity]
"I hope this works." He wanted to test a different way of using this skill.
The ants were exactly on that path.
Their hard and wet shells were touching each other, thousands of feet were running on the wet soil.
Lian knelt down and placed his palm on the ground, lightning went from his arm into the soil.
For a moment, nothing happened, then the ground in front of him exploded with white light.
The electric current passed under the first Soldier, the creature’s entire body contracted.
Its feet left the ground, and its jaws locked together with a loud sound, the lightning jumped from its shell to the Worker next to it.
Then to the third.
Fourth.
In the blink of an eye, a network of blue light formed among dozens of ants.
Lightning jumped from one body to another, all the creatures close to each other trembled at the same time.
The sharp smell of burnt shell, boiled blood, and wet soil spread in the air.
A few ants fell on their backs from the intensity of the contraction, some remained motionless, some were still alive, but their feet were hitting the ground irregularly.
The front wave stopped for a few seconds.
Lian lifted his hand from the soil, thin smoke rose from his fingertips.
Controlling Thunder Calamity for such a thing was harder than he had imagined.
Part of the lightning wanted to spread in all directions, he had been forced to hold the current within a small range using mana.
But those few seconds were enough, dozens of monsters were killed, and multiple notifications were sent to him.
And most importantly, finally!
[You leveled up!]
Nemi reached the other side of the gap, Ravian grabbed her arm and pulled her onto the ground, but Sera was still in the middle of the stem.
The wood under her feet made a loud sound, the old crack on the stem’s surface widened.
Sera stopped.
"Move!" Lian turned his head and shouted.
Sera took another step, this time the sound of breaking was clearer.
The middle part of the stem went down.
Sera lost her balance, Nemi shouted from the other side of the gap.
"Sera!"
The stem broke, the rotten piece under Sera’s feet separated and fell into the darkness.
"Nooooooo" She reached her hand toward the edge, but her fingers only grasped empty air.
"Sister! Damn it! No no no no no no" Ravian threw himself on his stomach and extended his arm.
"Nooooooo sisterrrrrrrr! Nooooo" The distance was too great, their fingertips didn’t meet.
Sera fell.
Nemi fell to her knees upon seeing this scene, and tears started pouring from her eyes at an unprecedented speed.
"Nooooooo"
"Damn it, now was not the time for this." Lian moved.
The electrocuted ants were still blocking the path, but the next row was climbing over their burned bodies.
A Soldier appeared directly in front of Lian, he lowered his shoulder, mana gathered in the muscles of his legs and torso.
[Iron Fortress Charge]
Lian charged forward, his shoulder hit the Soldier’s chest, the creature’s thick shell cracked with a loud sound, its body was thrown backward and took three Workers behind it with it.
Lian passed through the gap he had created.
A few metal jaws closed on him from both sides, but Diamond Skin formed on his arm and side for a moment.
The jaws slid on the hardened skin.
Lian reached the edge of the gap and jumped without slowing down, in the air, Sera was falling a few meters below.
Lian stretched his body forward to get closer to Sera’s falling body.
"Just a little more! Just a little more and I can save her!"
Could he save her?

sentences.text: The entire forest floor was moving.
Not metaphorically, and not because of the ground trembling.
The moss itself, the rotten leaves, and the dark layers of soil were rippling under the pressure of thousands of red and black bodies.
Crimson Needle Ants were pouring out from the darkness and advancing like a living flood among the massive roots.

Their antennae were twitching wildly, their metal jaws were clicking together with a dry and regular sound, and their countless legs were striking the ground so hard that the sound resembled heavy rain falling on thousands of roofs.
Ravian was running at the front.
He kept his body low, and with every step, he thrust his spear into the moss and thick stems to clear the path.
The spear’s tip hit narrow roots several times, and green sparks of mana jumped from the wood’s surface, but he did not slow down even for a moment.
Sera was holding her wounded shoulder with one hand and pulling Nemi with the other.
The wound under the wrapped cloth had opened again.
Blood was running down from the edge of the cloth and making a thin line on her arm, but the pressure of the ants’ feet behind them left no time to stop.
Nemi’s foot got caught in the moss several times.
Each time, Sera pulled her forward.
Lian was running at the back of the group, a position he had deliberately chosen.
From there, he could see the wave of ants, estimate the distance, and eliminate any creature that got too close to his companions.
Predator’s Instincts was working in his mind like a continuous alarm.
Danger was approaching from behind, very close, but not only from behind.
There was also a vague pressure from the front; weaker, more hidden, and at the same time more uncertain, Lian took his gaze off the ants every few seconds and checked the path ahead.
Tangled roots, short mushrooms, dark hollows, practically nothing clear could be seen.
Nevertheless, the unpleasant feeling did not disappear.
"Just run to the bitter mushroom path!
Once we enter their mist, the ants will lose our trail!" Ravian shouted without turning his head.
His voice was almost lost under the roar of thousands of feet, Lian looked at the wave behind them.
The first row of ants was now less than fifty meters away.
A few Workers were thinner than the rest and were crossing over the backs of their kind with unusual speed.
One of them jumped out from the moss and leaped high toward Sera.
Lian changed his path without stopping, cold mana gathered around his right hand, the air’s moisture turned white in an instant, and a layer of dark ice formed around his fingers.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
The ice claw extended along his fingers, the ant was still in the air when Lian passed by it.
A cold and dark line passed through the creature’s body, the Worker was split into two parts in the air.
The two halves of its body fell on the moss a few meters away, and its dark blood turned into ice crystals before it could fully spill.
The second ant approached from the left.
Lian spun, his heel hit the side of the creature’s head directly, and the sound of shell breaking like stone shattering was heard.
The ant’s body was slammed against the root wall and sank deep into the moss.
The third jumped from behind him, Lian ducked at the last moment, the metal jaws passed over his head, and he grabbed the front part of the ant’s body with both hands.
With a spin, he lifted the entire several-hundred-kilogram body of the monster and threw it toward the wave behind him.
The ant’s living body fell like a boulder among the advancing ranks.
A few Workers collided with it, some fell, but only a second later, dozens of ants climbed over their bodies and continued moving.
Lian frowned, every monster he killed only created a space the size of one step.
Behind that space, dozens of other bodies were moving, their numbers were so great that killing them was like trying to empty a river with bare hands.
His effort was practically useless.
Just how many of these bastards were there?
"We’re close!" Ravian jumped over a short root.
The group climbed up behind him.
Lian was the last one, before crossing the root, three more ants came up from behind.
He passed Glacial Reaper Claw through the first one’s jaw, slammed the second one’s head into the ground with his elbow, and kicked the third one back into the wave.
But the pressure from behind was increasing every moment, the sound of feet was no longer just heard, it was felt in the bones.
The ground trembled beneath their steps, and the tall moss on both sides of the path bent like grass under a flood.
Suddenly, Ravian stopped.
Lian almost hit his back, in front of them, a massive gap had opened its mouth.
Two giant roots had separated in the past, and the space between them had turned into a deep valley.
The walls of the gap were covered with small mushrooms and hanging roots, but its bottom disappeared into complete darkness.
No sound came from the bottom of the gap, no stones hitting, no water flowing, as if the gap had no end.
The only way to cross was a dry and thick stem that had fallen from one side of the gap to the other.
Compared to them, the stem looked like a narrow tree trunk, but its surface was full of cracks, and parts of it seemed rotten.
"Is this part of the plan too?" Sera gave her brother a tired look.
How were they supposed to get across this damn path?
Ravian only took one look behind them, the wave of ants was now coming over the previous root.
"We have no other choice." He stepped onto the stem without pausing, the wood groaned under his weight.
He kept his balance and crossed the gap quickly.
When he reached the other side, he turned back and kept his spear ready.
"Nemi, you first!"
The younger sister hesitated and was worried about falling, but when she looked behind her, she realized she had no other choice.
She sighed, and Nemi stepped onto the stem.
Her feet slipped on the first step, but Sera held her hand from behind, and the two moved forward carefully.
Lian remained on the previous side, the first Crimson Needle Worker jumped down from the root.
Then the second.
Then a large Soldier with a thick shell appeared among them.
Lian stood in front of the bridge.
None of them should get past him, if even two or three ants stepped onto the stem, their weight would be enough to break it.
Electrical energy began to move in his veins, a tingling feeling went down from his shoulders and gathered in his palms.
The air around his fingers cracked, thin blue and white lightning jumped between his nails.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: The Colony Of Ants III
paragraphs: Lian threw all his weight forward and finally managed to reach Sera.
"Reach out your hand!" He suddenly shouted.
The girl, who was still falling, upon hearing that voice that revived hope, her eyes shone with joy and tears of happiness came from her eyes.
Without a moment’s hesitation, she extended her hand, and Lian caught it. Her sudden weight pulled Lian’s shoulder down, and both swung toward the gap’s wall.
Lian raised his other hand, Glacial Reaper Claw formed again.
He sank the ice claws into the root wall with all his force, the wood and soil split, and their bodies hit the wall with an impact.
Sera let out a muffled groan, their legs hung above the darkness.
Pieces of wood fell from beside them and disappeared silently into the blackness.
But before they could even catch their breath, above them, the ants had reached the edge. One of the Workers jumped down without stopping.
Its feet stuck to the wall and it started climbing down.
Then a second appeared.
A third also hung from the edge.
"Lian..." Sera looked up, fear appeared again in her eyes, and she wanted to warn him, but—
"I know."
"Throw her up!" Ravian was leaning over the edge, relief appeared in his eyes upon seeing his sister was saved, and then he shouted with all his might.
Lian tightened his arm around Sera’s wrist, Glacial Reaper Claw was cracking in the wall.
The weight of both of them was breaking the ice from inside. The first ant was less than three meters away from them.
It raised its stinger, Lian placed his feet on the wall, and the muscles of his arm and shoulder contracted.
"Hold on tight, I’m throwing you up!" Then he threw Sera upward with all his force.
Her body shot up like a rocket and rose several meters in the air. Ravian grabbed her wrist, Nemi held Ravian’s waist from behind, and both pulled Sera onto the edge.
"Haha, I’m alive!" Sera’s face showed surprise and disbelief upon seeing that she was saved and now on the ground, and she was full of gratitude toward Lian.
Nemi threw herself into her sister’s arms and whispered.
"I’m glad you’re safe, I thought I was going to lose you! Sob sob"
Ravian only sighed in relief and returned to the edge to check on their rescuer’s condition.
At the same time, the ant shot its stinger toward Lian’s neck, and Lian moved his head aside, the stinger passed by his face and sank into the wall.
He pulled Glacial Reaper Claw out.
For a moment he fell, then he sank the claw higher and swung his body.
The second ant dropped itself from the edge, Lian placed both feet on the wall and jumped, the ice claw came out of the wood.
He climbed past the first ant and with a direct kick to its head, separated the creature from the wall.
The Worker fell into the darkness.
Lian grabbed the edge, and Ravian reached out his hand, but before he could help him, a few more ants appeared on the edge.
Lian pulled himself up, the first Worker opened its jaw, he passed the ice claw under its head, stepped on its falling body, and jumped to the other side of the gap.
"Haha, glad you’re okay." Ravian said with a smile upon seeing their rescuer was also safe.
Behind them, the remaining stem broke under the weight of the ants, and several Crimson Needle Ants fell into the gap along with the rotten wood.
But the main wave did not stop. The ants were climbing down along the walls, and some were making a living bridge over each other’s bodies.
"Move now!" Lian shouted without pausing. Now was not the time for pleasantries.
The four started running again.
Sera was breathing with difficulty, but she was still on her feet.
Lian looked at the girl’s wrist, the marks of his fingers remained on her skin because of the throw, but the bone seemed intact.
"Can you run?"
"If I had another choice, maybe not, but right now I have no other option." Sera said without looking at him.
Lian gave no short answer, he just took his position at the back of the group again.
The sounds behind them had become a little distant, but not for long. The ants would find a way through, they always did.
The bitter smell reached them before the mushrooms were seen. At first, it was only a mild burning in the nose, then the air became thicker.
A sharp and sour taste settled on the tongue and made breathing difficult.
"What a disgusting smell." Even Lian felt worse because of his stronger senses.
The two girls also felt nauseous and both covered their noses.
"We’re here!" Ravian increased his speed.
The massive roots moved aside, and a wide area appeared before them.
Hundreds of giant mushrooms were growing there, some only two or three meters tall.
Some others were so large that their caps cast shadows like the roof of a multi-story building over the ground.
Their stems were white, thick, and full of green veins. The caps had colors ranging from dirty yellow, dark green, and brown, and a colored mist was gently flowing from beneath them.
Yellow and green vapor had gathered near the ground, each wave accompanied by a bitter and suffocating smell.
Nemi coughed, and Sera covered her mouth with a cloth.
Ravian ran between two large mushrooms and pointed at them.
"We’re safe here. The ants hate this smell."
They took shelter behind the stem of one of the mushrooms. Lian stood at the edge of the area. The wave of ants appeared from among the moss.

The first row came toward the mushrooms at full speed, but as soon as they entered the mist, their movements slowed down. One of the Workers stumbled a few steps, its legs bent, and it fell on the ground.
The second one also started trembling.
For a moment, Ravian breathed a sigh of relief, thinking they were really saved.
Then the second row passed over their bodies. The ants did not stop. Dozens of bodies entered the mist.
Some fell, some fell on their sides, but the rest of the colony ruthlessly passed over them. The larger Soldiers entered the area directly.
The vapor settled on their shells, their bodies trembled, but they still continued moving.
"I thought you said this place was safe." Lian gave a tired look.
"This is not possible..." Ravian stepped back, disbelief evident in his eyes, his gaze fixed on the wave of ants.
"Even Soldiers shoulden’t enter here."
"They are here! Stick to the mushrooms and don’t even breathe!" Lian warned upon feeling the presence of the monsters.
The two girls and their brother said nothing and clung to the mushrooms, not even daring to breathe.
’Damn it damn it, why did those ants come this far? Are they really willing to go this far for revenge?’ Ravian thought in terror and cursed.
"Brother, didn’t you say they don’t come here? So what’s going on? Where the fuck your information come from?" Nemi looked at her brother with anger and shouted with the utmost fury.
